component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() out("issue.aliasField", [fieldOf(m.top, "childMaxHeight")]) m.top.childMaxHeight = 42 out("issue.findChild", [show(m.top.findNode("child"))]) out("issue.findOther", [show(m.top.findNode("other"))]) out("issue.findInnerOnly", [show(m.top.findNode("innerOnly"))]) other = m.top.findNode("other") out("issue.other.findChild", [show(other.findNode("child"))]) out("issue.other.getChild0", [show(other.getChild(0))]) out("issue.other.childCount", [other.getChildCount().toStr()])
for each name in ["AliasDeeper", "AliasInternalOnly", "AliasParentChildren", "AliasDynamic", "AliasClone"] n = CreateObject("roSGNode", name) n.callFunc("report", {}) end for end sub
